import.title: Import from Harvest
import.lead: Bring over your people, clients, projects, tasks, rates, time, expenses and invoices in one go. Nothing changes in Harvest.
import.step1: In Harvest, create a personal access token.
import.step2: Paste the token and the account ID shown next to it.
import.accountIdHint: A number, shown next to the token in Harvest.
import.receiptsHint: Downloads each receipt file. Takes longer for accounts with many expenses.
import.safe: The token is stored encrypted and deleted when the import finishes. People you import are added without an invitation; you choose whom to invite afterwards.
import.againLead: Run the import again to bring over what changed in Harvest. Records that already came over are updated, not duplicated.
import.running: Importing. You can leave this page; the import keeps running.
import.someDiffer_one: {{count}} total differs from Harvest. Check it below.
import.someDiffer_other: {{count}} totals differ from Harvest. Check them below.
import.nextInvite: Invite your team from the Team page when you are ready. Imported people get no email until you do.
import.nextRevoke: Revoke the personal access token in Harvest.
import.verificationLead: For each project and month: the hours and billable amount Honest Robin calculates from the imported entries, next to Harvest's own report.
import.roundingHint: Harvest rounds the total and Honest Robin rounds each entry, so amounts can differ by a fraction of a cent per entry.
import.syncOption: Keep bringing over changes from Harvest for a while
import.syncOptionHint: For switching gradually: new and changed entries in Harvest come over every 15 minutes until the day you choose, at most 30 days.
import.syncUntil: Keep syncing until the end of
import.syncing: New and changed entries, projects and people in Harvest come over every 15 minutes, until {{until}}.
import.syncRules: While syncing, Harvest's version wins, except for entries invoiced or timing here, which are kept and listed below. Entries deleted in Harvest are not deleted here.

csv.lead: Upload one of Harvest's CSV exports: the detailed time report (Reports → Detailed time → Export → CSV), or the clients, contacts or projects lists. You check how each column is read before anything is imported. Nothing connects to Harvest, so this works offline too. Import clients and projects first if you have those files; time entries create what's missing.
csv.columnsHint: Each field reads from the column shown. Fields marked * are needed.
csv.dateOrderNeeded: Every date in the file could be read either way. Say which it is.
csv.peopleHint: These people aren't in your team yet; they are added without being invited. Their email addresses aren't in Harvest's export: add them now, or later on the team page.
csv.willAdd: Adds {{clients}} clients, {{projects}} projects, {{tasks}} tasks and {{people}} people.
csv.problemsHint: They are skipped and listed afterwards; fix them in the file and import it again (nothing is duplicated).
csv.added: Added {{clients}} clients, {{projects}} projects, {{tasks}} tasks and {{people}} people.
csv.skipped_one: {{count}} row was skipped; see the list below.
csv.skipped_other: {{count}} rows were skipped; see the list below.
